en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Al Husayn Binusman, from Sama’at who said,
‘I asked Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> about the Khums, so he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘In everything what the people profit from a little or a lot’.
en.sarwar: 11. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from al-Husayn ibn ‘Uthman from Sama‘ who has said the following. “I asked abu al-Hassan about al-Khums. He said, “It is due on all small and large gains that people make.”
